# Support

Thanks for using AI CFO! Here's how to get help.

- **Questions & ideas** — start a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/ashutoshsharma1309/financeproj1/discussions).
- **Bugs** — open a [bug report](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) with steps to reproduce.
- **Feature requests** — open a [feature request](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md).
- **Security** — please follow the [security policy](../SECURITY.md); do not open a public issue.

Before filing a bug, please:

1. Confirm you're on the latest `main`.
2. Run `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`.
3. Include your browser, OS and any console errors.
